description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Rosemary Thyme,” a luxury condo in the heart of Rosemary Beach! Located steps away from shopping, dining, and the Barbados Pool, it features a spacious 1 King Suite, 2 full bathrooms, and a furnished balcony. Enjoy access to 4 community pools, 2 beach cruisers, and a vibrant coastal lifestyle. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Location: Situated in the heart of Rosemary Beach above town center, just steps from the best restaurants, shops, and beach access.Access to 4 Pools: Includes nearby Barbados Pool, Sky Pool, Coquina Pool, and Cabana Pool.Designer Interiors: Enjoy a spacious living area with a cozy sofa, dining space, and a fully equipped kitchen.Bikes Included: Explore charming Rosemary Beach with the 2 beach cruisers.Furnished Balcony: Relax with morning coffee or evening cocktails with views of West Long Green.Elevator Access: Convenient elevator to easily reach your unit without the hassle of stairs.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐“The property was clean and just as pictured. We loved the location—it was easy to walk or bike to restaurants and the beach! Communication with the host was great. Highly recommend!” – Erin B.⭐“Perfect condo in Rosemary Beach! Everything was spotless, and the location was ideal—we didn’t need the car once. The balcony was our favorite spot for morning coffee.” – Allyson W.⭐“Amazing location! This condo was perfect for our spring break trip. The pools were lovely, and we enjoyed being so close to shopping and dining options.” – Jared T.*** LIVING AREAS ***The open-concept living area invites you to relax in style, a large flat-screen TV, and comfortable seating. Adjoining the living space, the balcony is furnished with cozy seating, perfect for taking in the lively atmosphere of the Rosemary Beach.Large Smart TVCozy & Inviting SofaFurnished Balcony with views of West Long Green*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The fully equipped kitchen boasts upscale appliances and all the essentials you need to prepare delicious meals. The adjoining dining table provides a welcoming spot for family dinners or cozy brunches.Fully Equipped KitchenPremium, Stainless Steel AppliancesDining Table with Seating for 4*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***The luxurious primary bedroom features a king-sized bed dressed in upscale linens and a plush mattress to ensure restful nights. The en-suite bathroom includes granite countertops, a spacious vanity, and a shower/tub combo. A second full bathroom is available for guest convenience.Primary King Suite: King Bed with High-Quality Linens, flat-screen TV and En-Suite with single vanity and shower/tub comboGuest Bathroom: Conveniently located off the living area with single vanity and shower/tub combor*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Nestled in the vibrant heart of Rosemary Beach, this condo puts everything at your fingertips. Grab your morning coffee at Amavida Coffee, enjoy locally-loved dining spots like La Crema and Edwards Dining, or relax on the sugar-white sands just a short walk away.Rosemary Beach Community: Beachside destination with award-winning architectureRacquet Club – one of the world’s top 75 tennis spotsMultiple parks & greens with playgrounds, a splash pad, butterfly park, and hidden boardwalks with fountainsFitness Center with massage and yogaA Short Elevator Ride to Barrett Square3 Minute Walk to Cabana Pool4 Minute Walk to the Heated Sky Pool5 Minute Walk to Fitness Center and Tennis Courts4 RESORT POOLSBarbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 2 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 210874

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
